input.title: Recall reminders working session
input.summary: Marcus Webb said the front desk calls every patient by hand for recall appointments. The group agreed to automate six-month recall reminders first. New-patient follow-up was left for later.
decisions: Automate six-month recall reminders first; new-patient follow-up later.

actionItems.quote: I'll draft the three reminder templates and send them for your review by November 3.

followUp.subject: Recall reminders: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Marcus and Hana,

Thanks for the working session. We agreed to automate the six-month recall reminders first and to leave new-patient follow-up for later.

I will send three reminder templates for your review by November 3.

Best,
Jordan
